The {{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}} is used to craft wooden grave decorations and parts.  The [[Carpenter's workbench II]] is a direct upgrade to the [[Carpenter's workbench]] in terms of the energy required to craft and allows the building of [[lens]]es, [[steel chisel]]s and [[#wood|wooden constructions]].
